routines.tolerance: Existing 1e-12 absolute-or-relative comparison is adequate for these nonzero outputs (order-one/fractional components and large finite magnitudes). Small-magnitude vhat inputs produce order-one unit vectors, avoiding a meaningless sub-tolerance output comparison.
